listing.title: My First Kitchen Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Kitchen Pages – Frying Pan, Whisk, Rolling Pin & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly kitchen things!

Little hands color 30 kitchen pictures, from a frying pan, a kettle and a stove to a whisk, a rolling pin and a cookie jar. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines and a smiling face, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Cooking: Frying Pan, Kettle, Stove, Microwave, Blender, Mixer and Kitchen Timer
  • Baking: Whisk, Spatula, Rolling Pin, Mixing Bowl, Measuring Cup, Cookie Cutter, Muffin Tin, Cookie Jar, Oven Mitt and Chef Hat
  • Getting food ready: Cutting Board, Grater, Colander, Ladle, Spice Jars and Salt & Pepper
  • Mealtime and cleanup: Plate, Pitcher, Sippy Cup, Lunch Box, High Chair, Sink and Trash Can
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5 who love to watch, help and pretend in the kitchen.

Part of the my first step series.
